exposure: IPI length (<6 months, 7-17 months, 18-48 months, >49 months)
outcome: Anemia on admission to delivery room
cohort: 2514 women with an index multifetal delivery and a subsequent singleton gestation between 2005 and 2021
finding: Short interpregnancy intervals (IPI < 6 months) following a multifetal pregnancy are associated with an increased risk of preterm birth in a subsequent singleton pregnancy.
